% main.tex — multi-file fixture exercising flatten-tex source mapping.
%
% Build pipeline:
%   1. flatten-tex.py main.tex --out main-flat.tex
%   2. (compile with tectonic to produce main-flat.rrxiv.aux — for this
%      test we ship a pre-baked sidecar so the suite doesn't need a
%      LaTeX install)
%   3. rrxiv parse main-flat.tex
%
% The parser must report source_location.file == "chapters/chapter01.tex"
% (the original-file relative path) for the claim defined inside that
% input, not "main-flat.tex".

\documentclass{rrxiv}

\rrxivid{rrxiv-meaty-multifile}
\rrxivversion{v1}
\rrxivprotocolversion{0.2.0}
\rrxivlicense{CC-BY-4.0}

\title{Multi-file meaty-claim fixture}
\author{rrxiv Project}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
A fixture for multi-file source mapping via flatten-tex markers.
\end{abstract}

\input{chapters/chapter01}

\end{document}
